title: Sunday · the flats, wet-on-wet
logline: The mudflats in the new line: the channels bleeding into each other, the chimney a gray smear, and a man and a very old dog crossing slowly, the prints two-and-four and close together.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the flats wet-on-wet, channels bleeding into each other, the chimney a smear.

panels.name: Bleed

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
